notes.subject: וחטאי
notes.rationale: Root kh-t-' 'to miss (the mark)': 'sinneth against me' (KJV) vs 'misseth me / fails to find me' (JPS, YLT) — the missing echoes מצאי of v. 35.

notes.subject: נפשו
notes.rationale: נפש is throat/life-force, not immortal soul; rendered moya wa gagwe (his living breath).

notes.subject: מצאי / חטאי
notes.rationale: Antithesis find-vs-miss linking vv. 35-36; Sepedi pairs ntlhologela with foša.

translation: Eupša yo a fošago go nna o hlokofatša moya wa gagwe; bohle bao ba nkgolegago ba rata lehu.

tokens.gloss: eupša yo a fošago go nna
